heading.en: How does a cell copy two metres of DNA?
heading.kn: ಕೋಶ ಎರಡು ಮೀಟರ್ DNAಯನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ನಕಲು ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ?

hook.en: Before every cell division, the entire DNA must be copied accurately. E. coli does it in about 18 minutes.
hook.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಕೋಶ ವಿಭಜನೆಯ ಮೊದಲು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ DNA ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ ನಕಲಾಗಬೇಕು. E. coli ಇದನ್ನು ಸುಮಾರು 18 ನಿಮಿಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: Before every cell division, the entire DNA must be copied accurately. E. coli does it in about 18 minutes.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಕೋಶ ವಿಭಜನೆಯ ಮೊದಲು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ DNA ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ ನಕಲಾಗಬೇಕು. E. coli ಇದನ್ನು ಸುಮಾರು 18 ನಿಮಿಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Watson and Crick proposed that each strand acts as a template, so each new DNA molecule has one old and one new strand: semiconservative replication. In 1958 Meselson and Stahl grew E. coli in ¹⁵NH₄Cl, then moved them to ¹⁴N medium, and separated DNA by caesium chloride density gradient centrifugation. After one generation (20 min) all DNA was hybrid; after two generations (40 min) it was half hybrid and half light. Taylor showed the same in Vicia faba using radioactive thymidine.
body.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೊಸ DNAಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಹಳೆಯ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಹೊಸ ಎಳೆ: ಅರೆಸಂರಕ್ಷಿತ ಪ್ರತಿಕೃತಿ. ಮೆಸೆಲ್ಸನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಟಾಲ್ 1958ರಲ್ಲಿ ¹⁵N ಬಳಸಿ ಇದನ್ನು ಸಾಬೀತುಪಡಿಸಿದರು.

points.en: Each daughter DNA: one old + one new strand
Meselson & Stahl (1958): ¹⁵N → ¹⁴N, CsCl gradient
Gen 1: all hybrid; Gen 2: ½ hybrid, ½ light

narration.en: Watson and Crick proposed that each strand acts as a template, so each new DNA molecule has one old and one new strand: semiconservative replication. In 1958 Meselson and Stahl grew E. coli in ¹⁵NH₄Cl, then moved them to ¹⁴N medium, and separated DNA by caesium chloride density gradient centrifugation. After one generation (20 min) all DNA was hybrid; after two generations (40 min) it was half hybrid and half light. Taylor showed the same in Vicia faba using radioactive thymidine.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೊಸ DNAಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಹಳೆಯ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಹೊಸ ಎಳೆ: ಅರೆಸಂರಕ್ಷಿತ ಪ್ರತಿಕೃತಿ. ಮೆಸೆಲ್ಸನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಟಾಲ್ 1958ರಲ್ಲಿ ¹⁵N ಬಳಸಿ ಇದನ್ನು ಸಾಬೀತುಪಡಿಸಿದರು.

body.en: Replication starts at a definite site, the origin of replication, where the strands separate to form a replication fork. DNA-dependent DNA polymerase uses deoxyribonucleoside triphosphates, which supply both nucleotides and energy, and polymerises only in the 5'→3' direction. So one strand (leading) is made continuously and the other (lagging) discontinuously as short fragments, joined by DNA ligase. In eukaryotes replication occurs in the S-phase of the cell cycle.
body.kn: ಪ್ರತಿಕೃತಿ ಉಗಮ ಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. DNA ಪಾಲಿಮರೇಸ್ 5'→3' ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವುದರಿಂದ ಮುನ್ನಡೆ ಎಳೆ ನಿರಂತರ, ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ಎಳೆ ತುಂಡುತುಂಡಾಗಿ; DNA ಲೈಗೇಸ್ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

caption.en: The two strands unzip at the replication fork, and each acts as a template for a new strand.

tryThis.en: Notice that one new strand grows smoothly while the other is made in short pieces.

problem.en: E. coli with only ¹⁵N DNA are moved to ¹⁴N medium. After 60 minutes (generation time 20 min), what fraction of DNA molecules is hybrid (¹⁵N/¹⁴N) and what fraction light?

steps.en: The two original ¹⁵N strands are never broken, so they sit in 2 hybrid molecules.
The remaining 6 molecules are fully light.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. E. coli with only ¹⁵N DNA are moved to ¹⁴N medium. After 60 minutes (generation time 20 min), what fraction of DNA molecules is hybrid (¹⁵N/¹⁴N) and what fraction light?

body.en: After n generations, there are always exactly 2 hybrid molecules out of 2ⁿ. So hybrid fraction = 2/2ⁿ = 1/2ⁿ⁻¹.

narration.en: A quick memory trick. After n generations, there are always exactly 2 hybrid molecules out of 2ⁿ. So hybrid fraction = 2/2ⁿ = 1/2ⁿ⁻¹.

narration.en: Recap. Replication is semiconservative. Meselson and Stahl proved it with ¹⁵N and CsCl gradients. DNA polymerase works only 5'→3'. Lagging-strand fragments are joined by DNA ligase.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಕೃತಿ ಅರೆಸಂರಕ್ಷಿತ. ಮೆಸೆಲ್ಸನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಟಾಲ್ ¹⁵N ಮೂಲಕ ಸಾಬೀತುಪಡಿಸಿದರು. DNA ಪಾಲಿಮರೇಸ್ 5'→3' ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ. ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ಎಳೆಯ ತುಂಡುಗಳನ್ನು ಲೈಗೇಸ್ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
